[Intro: melodic disco bass line alone, handclaps, a cowbell]

[Verse 1: cool, low, bass and drums]
Took a class, took a trip
Took your photo off the fridge
Learned to cook for only one
Turns out I'm good, turns out it's fun

[Pre-Chorus: strings rise, kick drops out]
So if you're scrolling
If you're thinking of a text

[Chorus: four-on-the-floor, strings, gang answers]

Don't know you, don't miss
The way you used to keep me small
Walk on, don't call
If you see me out, I'm dancing

New number, who's this?

[Verse 2: cool, a little amused]
Heard you asked about my name
Heard you're sorry, heard you changed
That's so great, that's so sweet
Tell it to somebody else's feet

[Pre-Chorus: strings rise, kick drops out]
So if you're outside
If you're idling in the car
Stay exactly where you are

[Chorus: four-on-the-floor, strings, gang answers]
New number, who's this?
Don't know you, don't miss
The way you used to keep me small
Walk on, don't call
If you see me out, I'm dancing
If you see me, keep on passing
New number, who's this?

[Bridge: bass and claps only, half whispered]
Up, up
Out, out
Over, over
Done

[Final Chorus: everything, cowbell, string runs, ad-libs]
New number, who's this?
Don't know you, don't miss
The way you used to keep me small
Walk on, don't call
If you see me out, I'm dancing

New number, who's this?
